title: Interaction Design Internship
note: UI/interaction internship for students currently enrolled full-time in an industrial or product design program; fluent English required, Dutch a plus; apply by email.

facts.summary: Interaction/UI design intern in TEAMS' Amsterdam office, working with the Hamburg team.
facts.duties: Create and develop visual interfaces and consistent design patterns for digital applications; take part in UX methods and workshops.
facts.requirements: Full-time enrollment in industrial or product design; fluent English; Adobe and Figma; user-centered mindset.
facts.apply: Email portfolio, resume and cover letter to the address on the posting; email only.
